blocks.text: QUEZON, Bukidnon — A head-on collision between two motorcycles along the national highway in Barangay Puntian claimed two lives and left a woman injured early Thursday morning. Traffic investigator PMSgt. Roldan Perez Jr., of the Quezon Municipal Police Station, identified the dead as 51-year-old “Elmer” of Baliok, Talomo, Davao City, and 29-year-old “Daren” of Barangay Lumbayao, Valencia City, Bukidnon. Elmer’s live-in partner, 43-year-old Josephine, survived with injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment at a hospital in Maramag, Bukidnon.
